description: Remember a decision, gotcha, or win across sessions by writing it to the project soul (soul.fafm) with faf-cli's Soul. Returns the stored memory and the soul's size. Re-etching an id updates that memory in place. Use it to persist something an AI should recall later; faf_recall reads them back.

id.description: Stable id — re-etching the same id updates in place (dedup)

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

priority.description: Recall ranks by priority then recency

tags.description: Tags (e.g. decision, gotcha, win) for filtering + recall coupling

text.description: The memory to remember — capture the why (decision/gotcha/win)

name: faf_etch
title: Etch Memory
